up: List all approved drugs indicated for leukemia, including their ChEMBL ID, name, SMILES, EFO ID, indication label, and max phase for that indication.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.mesh_heading AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE di.mesh_heading LIKE '%leukemia%' AND md.max_phase = 4;
